<title
    level="1"
    right="Feat 12"
    pfs="Standard"
>
[Rock Rampart](/Feats.aspx?ID=4232) <actions string="Three Actions" />
</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Earth" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=55" />
<trait label="Impulse" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=502" />
<trait label="Kineticist" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=504" />
<trait label="Manipulate" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=104" />
<trait label="Overflow" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=506" />
<trait label="Primal" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=134" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Rage of Elements](/Sources.aspx?ID=205) pg. 27

</column>

---

Drawing on your connection to the [Plane of Earth](/Planes.aspx?ID=5), you form a wall of rock and earth. This has the effect of [_wall of stone_](/Spells.aspx?ID=365), but the wall's maximum length is 40 feet. The wall lasts until the end of your next turn, but you can Sustain it up to 1 minute.

---
**Level (+4)** The maximum length of the wall increases by 10 feet, and the Hit Points of each section increase by 5.
name: Rock Rampart
